assertions.description: 前置：主车 20% 取得 211 的预占与 CHARGING 用途，它的充电单 RIoT 收下、停在 1 QUEUEING 没派车（executeVehicleKey --）；第二台 25% 排队，报「211 已被预占」
单一直不派车，30 秒窗口过后：主车那趟充电写上 CHARGING_ORDER_NOT_DISPATCHED、服务端日志告警一次（事件 2284）；211 仍是主车的预占，RIoT 上那张单仍是 1 QUEUEING、没有执行车，命令审计里没有任何订单命令（不取消、不放桩），第二台仍分不到
assertions.expected: CHARGING_ORDER_NOT_DISPATCHED | 1 alarms | RESERVED BROKERX-L2-0001 charging:BROKERX-L2-0001:20261026T080843216Z | 1 -- | 0 order commands | second (none)
assertions.actual: | 0 alarms | RESERVED BROKERX-L2-0001 charging:BROKERX-L2-0001:20261026T080843216Z | 1 -- | 0 order commands | second (none)

assertions.description: 主车在 RIoT 掉线、人在 RIoT 取消那张单：服务端照取消走（ORDER_ENDED_WITHOUT_ARRIVAL、不重建），车证明不了停稳，211 仍预占；L2-R11 确认清桩：CONFIRMED、stationReleased=true；之后第二台取得 211 的预占与 CHARGING 用途。主车的充电单只建过一张
assertions.expected: ORDER_ENDED_WITHOUT_ARRIVAL | RESERVED BROKERX-L2-0001 charging:BROKERX-L2-0001:20261026T080843216Z / CONFIRMED released=1 / RESERVED BROKERX-L2-0002 | CHARGING / 1 main intents, 0 rebuilds
assertions.actual: ORDER_ENDED_WITHOUT_ARRIVAL | RESERVED BROKERX-L2-0001 charging:BROKERX-L2-0001:20261026T080843216Z / CONFIRMED released=1 / RESERVED BROKERX-L2-0002 | CHARGING / 1 main intents, 0 rebuilds
